items.selection_reason: This clearly depicts a later script form that can be compared with the reported crossroads-like early graph; it is a modern rendering, so it does not document the ancient form itself.

limitations.text: The image shows a modern small-seal-style rendering, not an ancient inscription. The available evidence describes early 行 as a crossroads or thoroughfare but does not provide an inspected early glyph image here, so the image cannot establish the detailed graphic development or which spoken sense came first.
